world: 02 — Chrome ("the metal runs live") — reference pole hildenkaira.fi, rebuilt at /home/dev/agents/design/site/worlds/02-chrome/index.html + /home/dev/agents/design/site/src/worlds/02-chrome/ (files: tokens.css, world.css, main.ts [theme toggle, observers, entrances], masthead.ts [the live centerpiece], plates.ts [seeded assay-plate canvases], stickers.ts [hand-drawn SVG layer]). Revised after adversarial critique of the draft: the metaball O now has a carved counter (ring charges + fixed negative center charge), the camera fit math is corrected for a letterbox strip, the O matches cap height 1.0, click uses a hit proxy, plate scatter is exact.
policy: Both modes. Day = greige rgb(234,233,230) editorial calm; night = ink #181818 — legitimate because the reference itself flips mid-page to #181818 with the serif intact (measured), so the palette is night-native, not inverted by force. Inline head script reads localStorage 'hub-theme' (fallback prefers-color-scheme) and sets html[data-theme] BEFORE first paint — scheme-correct, zero flash; the world's own toggle (28px tall, radius 0, hand-drawn engraved sun/crescent) writes back to 'hub-theme' for lab-wide continuity. Night is specced surface-by-surface, never a blind invert: page #EAE9E6→#181818; ink text #181818→#EAE9E6; S3 counter-slab inverts the OTHER way (#181818→#EAE9E6 — the reference's flip grammar survives in both modes); S4 slab #FFFFFF→#232322; footer #2B2B2B→#101010; assay plates are physical paper objects and do NOT redraw at night (paper plates on an ink table — exactly how the reference leaves its photos alone in its dark section); pistachio #ECFDAD / jade #3FAE86 / vermilion #FF4C24 keep identical hex in both modes; pistachio buttons keep ink text at night; masthead canvas stays transparent in both, with toneMappingExposure 1.15→0.95 and material.envMapIntensity 1.25→1.0 at night (darker chrome, same HDRI), tweened 0.8s on flip. Theme flip 800ms cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) on background-color/color only — matches the hub's 800ms so crossing from hub to world feels like one building. In still-frame mode the flip sets the new values and re-renders one frame.
typecasting: Display serif: ZODIAK (Fontshare, ITF FFL, variable 100–900 + variable italic). It wins the PP Editorial New stand-in on three grounds: (1) it is the only FFL candidate with genuine high-contrast razor hairlines and sharp triangular serifs — the "magazine masthead with a blade in it" register Editorial New owns; (2) Sentient is humanist/bookish (too soft), Erode's chewed terminals read zine not glossy, Boska is spiky poster display that collapses at the 2.9vw ladder step; (3) the variable weight axis supplies the wght-700 cut for the 3D extrusion from the SAME family — poured metal needs mass, and the reference's own masthead letters are far fatter than its HTML type, so one family covers both. Usage law (measured, non-negotiable): Zodiak 400 owns EVERY HTML heading and numeral — lh 0.9, letter-spacing −0.02em, vw-fluid ladder 5.82/4.36/4.0/3.27/2.9vw; italic 400 allowed only for one-word inline emphasis; wght 700 exists ONLY as extruded 3D geometry plus the rung-3 fallback artwork (aria-hidden graphic, not a heading). UI grotesk: SWITZER (Fontshare, ITF FFL) at ≤14px, weight 500, lh 1.3 — argued over the already-hosted General Sans because (a) PP Neue Montreal is a Swiss neo-grotesque and Switzer is Fontshare's expressly Neue-Haas-lineage family (ASSETS.md lists it as the "stricter" 02 option), while General Sans carries geometric warmth; (b) General Sans is the HUB's text voice, and since the grotesk here IS the entire ≤14px UI layer, sharing it would make the world read like the hub — forbidden. Cost: two woff2 (~30KB each) under the FFL text already at site/public/fonts/licenses/fontshare-FFL.txt. Already self-hosted and NOT used here: General Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, Clash Display, Sometype Mono, Outfit.

sections.name: S1 — Masthead: the pour (100vh slab, greige/ink)
sections.spec:
**Ground** day #EAE9E6 / night #181818, min-height 100dvh, margin 0 (strict slab law: zero vertical gaps page-wide). Side padding clamp(20px, 5vw, 72px) on copy only — the canvas is full-bleed.

**Head:** preload /fonts/Zodiak-Variable.woff2 + /fonts/Switzer-Variable.woff2 (font/woff2, crossorigin) + the inline data-theme script before first paint.

**Page chrome (fixed, z above canvas):** top-left 12px Switzer w500 lh 1.3, uppercase, tracking +0.04em: `02 — CHROME`. Top-right row, gap 8px: theme toggle (28px tall, radius 0, ink fill day / greige fill night, 14×14 hand-drawn engraved sun/crescent — see assets) + hub button (28px, radius 0, ink fill, label 12px Switzer `HUB`, 14×14 ink arrow-square rotated 225°, hover = jade #3FAE86 child layer sliding in translateX(−101%)→0, 0.525s cubic-bezier(0.625,0.05,0,1)).

**Masthead:** the live CHROME strip (see centerpiece). Canvas full-width, flush to viewport top, height EXACTLY the measured band: clamp(160px, 17.4vw, 300px). Letters' cap height = 62% of canvas height, vertically centered — no dead airband below the word (draft flaw fixed: the canvas IS the 17.4vw strip, not a taller frame around it). Canvas pointer-events none; pointer/raycast listeners live on the section.

**Copy block** (below strip, left-aligned, max-width 56ch, margin-top 4vh):
- Eyebrow: pistachio #ECFDAD tag, radius 0, padding 6px 10px, 12px Switzer w500 uppercase: `LANE 02 — POURED LIVE`
- Statement, Zodiak 400, 3.27vw ladder step, lh 0.9, −0.02em (deliberately NOT the 5.82 step — luminance supremacy: nothing outrenders the metal): line 1 `Nothing here is baked.` line 2 `The metal runs live.`
- Sub, 14px Switzer w500 lh 1.3, max-width 34ch: `An editorial set in liquid chrome. One studio HDRI does the lighting, marching cubes keep the O molten, and the serif stays razor-calm about it.`
- Buttons row, gap 10px: [pistachio fill, ink text] `SEE THE ASSAYS` → #assays; [ink fill, greige text] `HOW IT'S LIT` → #foundry. Both 28px tall / radius 0 / 14×14 ink arrow-square / jade slide hover.

**Stickers:** molten asterisk 96px anchored right of the strip's E (top 4vw, right 6vw); chrome drop 72px at bottom-left quarter of the slab. Both idle-float on the measured grammar (rotation ±1°/s inside a seeded ±5–12° band, ±5% scale breathing, ~9s period, phases from mulberry32).

**Entrance:** letters pour in (see centerpiece), then copy lines rise in clip-path masks translateY 110%→0, 0.9s THE bezier, stagger 0.09s; buttons fade+rise last (0.525s, delay 0.7s). Semantics: visually-hidden h1 `Chrome — lane 02 of the design lab`.

**Small screens (≤820px):** canvas clamp floor 160px keeps the word legible via the camera fit formula; copy block padding drops to 20px; statement stays vw-fluid (3.27vw of a phone is small by design — it reads as a caption under the metal, acceptable; do NOT break the ladder).

sections.name: S2 — Assay wall (100vh slab, greige) #assays
sections.spec:
**Ground** #EAE9E6 day / #181818 night. Two-zone layout: left column 34vw sticky copy (top 12vh), right 58vw plate field, min-height 100dvh.

**Copy:** kicker pistachio tag `THE WALL`; heading Zodiak 400 at the 5.82vw top step (the page's biggest HTML type — the measured masthead step), lh 0.9, −0.02em, three lines: `Print calm.` / `Mirror finish.` / `No photographs.` Body 14px Switzer w500 lh 1.3, max-width 36ch: `We own no camera. The seven plates on this wall were drawn by a seeded machine — same seed, same plate, every visit. The tilt is the only nostalgia we kept.`

**Plate field (exact scatter, positions as % of the 58vw × 86vh field container, plates 12vw wide, aspect 0.80 portrait):** P1 left 1% top 4%; P2 left 34% top 0%; P3 left 66% top 7%; P4 left 6% top 48%; P5 left 21% top 55% (overlaps P4's right third — the collage pair); P6 left 48% top 46%; P7 left 72% top 52%. Rotations: mulberry32(0xA55A + index), rot = (rnd()×2−1)×4.5° for all plates EXCEPT the P4/P5 pair which uses ×5.0° and carries the 2px solid #ECFDAD border — the measured founders-pair exception (day ground P4, night ground P5). All other plates: NO border, NO shadow, NO radius — rotation alone does the polaroid cue (measured law). Captions live inside the drawn canvas (see assets2d).

**Sticker:** drawn ampersand 128px overlapping P6/P7 at z-index above plates, idle-floating — homage to the reference's molten ampersand, in our hand.

**Motion:** plates enter on IntersectionObserver 20%: rise 40px + rotate from 0° to their seeded angle, 0.9s THE bezier, stagger 0.06s (GSAP owns all transforms). Hover: plate straightens to 0° and lifts to scale 1.03, 0.525s THE bezier; siblings unaffected. Scroll parallax: plates ride two parent layers at factors 0.92 / 1.06 (measured: translation lives on a parent layer, never on the floated element).

**Small screens (≤820px):** left column unsticks and stacks full-width; field becomes a 2-column grid (gap 6vw, padding 20px), plates 40vw wide, same seeds and rotations.

Each card: engraved index numeral top-right, Zodiak 400 at the 2.9vw step, ink at 30%; title Zodiak 400 2.9vw lh 0.9; body 13px Switzer w500 lh 1.3, max-width 30ch; padding 2vw.

Heading line rises in its mask during the first 15% of the runway. (Scrub note: the bezier shapes each card's ramp inside the scrubbed timeline; scroll position remains the clock.)

sections.spec:
**Ground** #2B2B2B day (the measured footer value) / #101010 night; text #EAE9E6. Content bottom-anchored, side padding clamp(20px, 5vw, 72px), min-height 100dvh.

**Copy:** heading Zodiak 400, 4.0vw step, lh 0.9, −0.02em, two lines: `Poured in the lab,` / `set nowhere.` Line below, 13px Switzer w500 lh 1.3, max-width 40ch: `Lane 02 of four. The chrome cools when you leave — localStorage remembers whether you left at night.`

**Buttons row**, gap 10px, 28px tall / radius 0 / 14×14 ink arrow-square / jade slide hover: [pistachio fill, ink text, arrow rotated 225°] `BACK TO THE HUB` → / ; [VERMILION #FF4C24 fill, ink text] `NEXT LANE — 03 MONUMENT` → /worlds/03-monument/. The vermilion button is the page's SINGLE vermilion use (measured: vermilion has one genuine UI use on the reference — a scalpel, not a brush). Nothing else on any surface may be vermilion — not stickers, not plates, not focus rings.

**Meta line**, 11px Switzer w500, 40% opacity, uppercase, tracking +0.06em: `ZODIAK · SWITZER · STUDIO_SMALL_08 · 6 DRAW CALLS · SEED 0x5EED02` — museum-label self-description, not a credits ritual.

**Motion:** heading mask-rise on enter, 0.9s THE bezier. The vermilion button gets NO idle animation — it earns attention by being the only hot thing in the room.

centerpiece: THE LIVE MASTHEAD — "CHROME, and the O never sets." The reference's masthead is 12 pre-rendered AVIF letter sprites in a 17.4vw flush-top strip; ours is the same strip anatomy computed live. File: site/src/worlds/02-chrome/masthead.ts. TECHNIQUE — beveled extruded serif letterforms with ONE marching-cubes molten glyph: the word CHROME as five extruded Zodiak-700 letters (C H R M E from /type/zodiak-bold-chrme.typeface.json via FontLoader) plus the O as a live THREE.MarchingCubes metaball mass — the exact mirror of the reference's crisp-letters-plus-molten-ampersand move, at 60fps. GEOMETRY: TextGeometry per glyph, size 1.0 (cap height 1 world unit), depth 0.34, curveSegments 8, bevelEnabled, bevelThickness 0.09, bevelSize 0.05, bevelSegments 5 (rounded poured-metal shoulders that sweep HDRI highlights; 700 weight keeps hairlines wider than 2×bevelSize); ~18k tris total. Letter layout is METRIC, not eyeballed: per-glyph advance = geometry.boundingBox width, x cursor accumulates advance + 0.02 tracking, word then re-centered so its midpoint sits at x 0; expected span ≈ 4.8 units. THE O (critique fix — the draft's blob would collapse into a filled disc and break the word): MarchingCubes(resolution 36 — drop to 28 below 4 logical cores — shared material, maxPolyCount 20000), scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.26) so outer diameter = cap 1.0 exactly (never smaller than its siblings) and z-extent 0.52 matches the letter depth stack (0.34 + 2×0.09). Field composition from mulberry32(0x5EED02), cache-stable, never Math.random: FIVE positive charges strength 0.9 / subtract 12 orbiting a RING (field-space radius 0.45, angular speeds 0.4–0.9 rad/s, phases/radii seeded, ring wobble ±0.06) + ONE FIXED NEGATIVE charge strength −0.55 / subtract 12 at the center (MarchingCubes.addBall handles negative strength — it carves). Result: a molten O whose counter wobbles and breathes but never closes — legibility of the word is the premium test. INTERACTIONS: (1) pointer-x/y on the hero section drives per-letter target rotation.y = px·0.14 + proximity tilt up to ±8°, approached by viscous per-frame lerp 0.06 — molten inertia, never a tween; (2) agitation: pointer velocity adds up to +0.8 rad/s to charge speeds, decaying over 1.2s; (3) click = splash: raycast an invisible hit-proxy (TorusGeometry r 0.33 tube 0.18, MeshBasicMaterial visible:false — raycasts hit geometry regardless) parked in the O slot, NEVER raycast the live metaball; on hit, GSAP tweens positive-charge strength 0.9→1.5→0.9 over 0.9s THE bezier; (4) idle: each letter runs the measured float grammar — rotation ±1°/s inside a seeded ±5–8° band + ±5% scale breathing on ~9s period, phases from mulberry32 per letter; (5) entrance pour: letters start y −1.2 / rotationX 25° (fully outside the visible band), rise 1.1s stagger 0.07s THE bezier; metaball strength ramps 0→0.9 over 1.4s. MATERIAL (one shared instance): MeshStandardMaterial{ metalness 1.0, roughness 0.06, envMapIntensity 1.25 day / 1.0 night }; scene.environment = PMREM of /hdri/studio_small_08_1k.hdr (CC0); scene.background null, renderer alpha:true — the greige/ink page IS the backdrop. LIGHTS: zero. Metalness-1 chrome is lit entirely by the environment; the expensive look is the HDRI's, free. RENDERER: ACESFilmic, exposure 1.15 day / 0.95 night, dpr min(devicePixelRatio, 1.75), antialias true. CAMERA (critique fix — the draft's horizontal-fov fit crops caps vertically in a wide-short strip): PerspectiveCamera with FIXED vertical fov 12°; on every resize z = max(7.71, 24.26 / aspect) — derived from required visible height 1.62 units (cap 1.0 at 62% of strip) and required visible width 5.1 (word span 4.9 × 1.04 margin): 7.71 = 1.62/(2·tan6°), 24.26 = 5.1/(2·tan6°). Desktop fits by height, portrait fits by width, nothing ever crops. DRAW CALLS: 5 letters + 1 metaball = 6 (budget ≤40; the hit proxy does not draw). HYGIENE: IntersectionObserver pauses the loop AND the CPU marching-cubes field update below 15% visibility; document.visibilitychange pauses on hidden tab; ResizeObserver refits via the z formula; theme flip tweens exposure + envMapIntensity 0.8s (still mode: set values, re-render once); still-frame path runs the seeded composition at t=2.5, calls mc.update() once, renders one frame — identical poster every visit; full disposal on teardown (geometries, PMREM target, renderer.forceContextLoss) following the proven pattern in /home/dev/agents/design/site/src/worlds/01-noir/scene.ts.
assets2d: The world's image language is FOUNDRY PAPERWORK: everything looks issued by the lab that poured the metal. (1) THE CHROME RAMP — one canonical banded gradient reused everywhere 2D: stops 0 #FBFBF9, .20 #D8D7D3, .46 #8F8E8A, .54 #232322 (the hard ink HORIZON — the classic airbrushed-chrome tell), .60 #C9C8C4, .82 #EFEEEA, 1 #FAFAF8. Hard horizon + discrete banding = drawn chrome, never a soft slop gradient. (2) SEVEN ASSAY PLATES (plates.ts) — the photo stand-ins: 480×600 offscreen canvases (aspect 0.80, backing ×min(dpr,2)), each seeded mulberry32(0xA55A + index), drawn ONCE after document.fonts.ready (engraved numerals need Zodiak loaded): ground #F4F3F0 flat + paper tooth (per-pixel L jitter ±6, alpha 0.04); one central specimen shape seeded from {bar, disc, arc, teardrop} filled with the ramp drawn as ~24 discrete horizontal bands whose stop positions jitter ±3px by seed, 1px white specular line at 30% height, ordered-dither dot pass alpha 0.05 over the specimen only; engraved index Zodiak 400 64px ink-85% top-left (`01`…`07`); caption strip bottom 44px above a 1px ink rule, 11px Switzer uppercase +0.04em: `ASSAY 01 — HORIZON JITTER ±3PX`, `ASSAY 02 — ORDERED DITHER`, `ASSAY 03 — DAY GROUND`, `ASSAY 04 — NIGHT GROUND` (the pistachio-bordered pair: 04 drawn on #232322 ground with greige marks), `ASSAY 05 — BAND COUNT 24`, `ASSAY 06 — SPECULAR .30`, `ASSAY 07 — SEED 0xA55A`. Same seed, same plate, every visit; plates never redraw on theme flip (physical paper). (3) FOUR HAND-DRAWN METALLIC SVG STICKERS (stickers.ts, viewBox 0 0 96 96, shared defs: linearGradient #ramp = the canonical ramp, vertical; linearGradient #sweep = an 18°-tilted white specular stripe, opacity .85→0, GSAP animates its gradientTransform on hover): — MOLTEN ASTERISK: six droplet lobes from center (48,48), each a filled outline path, belly width 14 tapering to a 2-wide tip at radius 34, placed via rotate(n·60 48 48); center disc r 7; the 300° lobe elongated to r 41 with a detached drip bead circle r 2.6 at its tip — the molten tell. — DRAWN AMPERSAND (homage to the reference's molten ampersand; our own path, never typeset): two crossing loops as a single filled outline, stroke modulation thick 12 / thin 3, tail exiting to (78,84) ending in a hanging bead r 3.4; ramp rotated 8°. — INGOT: isometric prism — top face (24,38)-(60,30)-(76,40)-(40,48), front face dropped 18px, side face closing; three ramp fills at three gradientTransform angles (top lightest, side darkest); engraved `02` on the front face, 9px Zodiak, ink 60%. — DROP: teardrop from tip (48,18) to belly r 22 at (48,62), ramp fill, white rounded-rect specular slash 4×18 rotated −22° at (40,48), drawn landing ring below — 1.5px ink-25% ellipse (48,88) rx 14 ry 3. All stickers idle-float via GSAP on the measured grammar. (4) DRAWN UI GLYPHS: the 14×14 arrow-square (ink square + our own 8×8 arrow path, 1.5px stroke, square caps, 45°) and the toggle's engraved sun (circle r 3.5 + 8 ticks 1.5×2.5 at 45° steps) / crescent (two arcs), swapped by a 0.525s clip reveal. Zero Lucide, zero emoji, zero stock — every mark on this page is ours.
motion: ONE ease rules the DOM: cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1) — the measured signature (92 of 96 transitions on the reference; here 100%). Tokens: --ease-chrome in tokens.css and GSAP CustomEase.create('chrome','M0,0 C0.625,0.05 0,1 1,1'). DURATIONS: 0.525s = every hover/UI state (the measured workhorse); 0.9s = copy line-rises and plate entrances; 1.1s = masthead letter pour (stagger 0.07s); 0.8s = theme flip (background-color/color only, 800ms cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) — matches the hub). VOCABULARY: entrances = clip-path mask + translateY 110%→0 line-rises, stagger 0.09s/line, fired by IntersectionObserver at 20%; hovers = the jade layer slide (child span translateX(−101%)→0) on EVERY button including the vermilion one; plates straighten to 0° + scale 1.03 on hover; stickers get a specular sweep (GSAP attr on #sweep gradientTransform, 0.525s) + scale 1.06. IDLE = the measured float grammar verbatim: rotation ±1°/s inside a seeded ±5–12° band + ±5% scale breathing (~9s period), phases from mulberry32 — applied to stickers and masthead letters; scroll translation ONLY on parent layers (factors 0.92/1.06), never on the floated element itself (measured). SCENE motion is the one tween exception: pointer response is per-frame viscous lerp 0.06 (molten inertia), agitation decays 1.2s. RUNWAY: S3 ScrollTrigger scrub 0.6 over 250vh, cards translateY 160px / translateZ −160px → 0 (measured entry vector), 'chrome' ease inside the scrubbed timeline. OWNERSHIP LAW: GSAP owns every element transform; the single CSS transition:transform permitted is on the .btn-fill child span (jade layer) — an element GSAP never touches (the hub's stranded-entrance bug stays fixed). prefers-reduced-motion: all idles/pours/scrubs off, entrances become 0.3s opacity fades, the scene renders the seeded still frame.
fallback: Four-rung ladder; no rung ever shows a broken page. RUNG 1 — live: real GPU detected → full loop, dpr ≤1.75, IntersectionObserver + hidden-tab pause. RUNG 2 — designed still frame: on init read UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL; if /swiftshader|llvmpipe|software/i → compose ONE frame at dpr 1 and cancel the loop (pattern proven in site/src/worlds/01-noir/scene.ts): letters at their seeded idle rotations at t=2.5, mc.update() called once so the metaball field evaluates at its most sculptural seeded phase — seed 0x5EED02 makes this frame identical every visit: an art-directed poster, not a freeze. Pointer listeners never attach; on theme flip the new exposure/envMapIntensity values are set and one frame re-renders. RUNG 3 — CSS fallback (WebGL context creation fails): .masthead-fallback sits in the DOM behind the canvas from first paint — the word CHROME set in HTML Zodiak 700 at ~13vw / lh 0.9 (artwork exception to the 400 law; the element is aria-hidden, the visually-hidden h1 carries semantics), chrome rendered via background-clip:text with the canonical ramp (hard #232322 horizon at 54% — drawn banding, not a slop gradient), the O replaced by an inline SVG molten-O: hand-drawn irregular ring path (outer belly r 34, inner counter offset 3px low-right, one drip bead at 320°) filled with #ramp; one specular sweep animates background-position over 1.2s on load, then the poster holds still. Under it the full DOM page runs untouched — plates, stickers, and every section are 2D and never degrade. RUNG 4 — context lost mid-session: webglcontextlost handler calls preventDefault() and sets canvas visibility:hidden (a lost context paints WHITE — never let it flash), revealing .masthead-fallback; webglcontextrestored re-renders (still frame on rung-2 hardware, loop otherwise) and swaps back. Teardown disposes geometries, the PMREM target, and forces context loss so back/forward navigation never leaks a context.
distinct: Chrome is the only room in the lab where warm print calm and liquid metal coexist — and every neighbour is disqualified from that sentence by measurement. The hub is cream toy-box: 32px-radius color cards, chunky Cabinet Grotesk at 850, sentence-case chips, a playful diorama — Chrome has radius 0 everywhere, a razor high-contrast serif locked at weight 400 / lh 0.9, greige stone instead of cream, and its one toy is a molten letter O with a carved counter. Noir (01) is a two-color charcoal/bone night with 10px mono labels and light as the only event — Chrome is daylight editorial with a three-accent system (pistachio workhorse, jade hover, one vermilion scalpel) and a real material as the event. Monument (03) is a white void of colossal condensed CAPS sliced by hairlines, anti-decoration — Chrome is upper-and-lowercase serif warmth, decorated deliberately with drawn stickers and assay plates. Pulse (04) is one saturated red where a single variable grotesk does everything by weight — Chrome never lets its hot color out more than once per page and casts a serif no other target touches. And against its own reference pole the twist IS the identity: hildenkaira's chrome is baked AVIF; ours computes every reflection live — five milled letters and one O that never sets — and the page says so out loud.
